## Verdict

**Dorado** costs least for a team of 9, at **$171 per month**. It has the highest per-seat rate on the list, but it is the only vendor whose minimum (1 seat) falls below the team size, so the team pays for exactly 9 seats. Inkwell's cheaper $8 rate is nearly enough to overcome its 10-seat floor — it lands at $80, well under Dorado — so the headline ranking turns on the arithmetic rather than the minimums alone.

Correction to the above: Inkwell at $80 per month is the cheapest option. Dorado's $171 is second, Borealis's $300 third.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Dorado | $19 | 1 |
| Inkwell | $8 | 10 |
| Borealis | $12 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 9 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Dorado:** minimum 1 < 9, so 9 seats paid. 9 × $19 = **$171 per month**. Effective rate $19.00 per person.
- **Inkwell:** minimum 10 > 9, so 10 seats paid. 10 × $8 = **$80 per month**. One unused seat, worth $8. Effective rate $8.89 per person ($80 ÷ 9).
- **Borealis:** minimum 25 > 9, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $12 = **$300 per month**. Sixteen unused seats, worth $192. Effective rate $33.33 per person ($300 ÷ 9).

Inkwell is $91 per month cheaper than Dorado and $220 per month cheaper than Borealis — $1,092 and $2,640 per year.

## Risks

Inkwell's one-seat overage is trivial at $8 per month, and it disappears entirely at 10 people. Below 9 the penalty grows but Inkwell stays cheapest down to roughly 5 people, where Dorado's $95 still exceeds Inkwell's $80 floor; Dorado only wins below about 4 seats.

Borealis's $300 is fixed until headcount reaches 25, at which point its effective rate drops to $12 — still above Inkwell's $8, so it does not overtake Inkwell on list price at any size.

This comparison covers price only. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, or security posture, so the cheapest seat may not be a comparable product. All figures assume monthly billing at list rate as stated; annual commitments, discounts, onboarding fees, and contract exit terms are not in the source and could reorder these results.
